Weddings at Darver Castle
Your fairy-tale begins the moment you pass through the ancient gates of Darver Castle Estate, a magnificent 15th-century haven nestled in the heart of County Louth. Steeped in history since 1432, this enchanting castle is now a cherished destination for unforgettable weddings, where romance and heritage intertwine. Once a noble stronghold and now a lovingly restored estate, Darver Castle is dedicated to creating magical moments that last a lifetime. Surrounded by lush parkland and cared for by a passionate team, every detail is thoughtfully tailored to ensure your celebration is as timeless as the castle itself. One of Ireland’s most sought-after castle wedding venues, located in the beautiful countryside of County Louth — just one hour from Dublin and Belfast.
Download Wedding Pricing
Plan your Dream wedding with Darver Castle Estate
At Darver Castle, your wedding day is completely private. We host only one wedding per day, giving you exclusive access to the entire castle and grounds.
From elegant reception rooms to manicured gardens and our grand ballroom, every space is yours to enjoy with family and friends — making us one of the most unique exclusive-use wedding venues in Ireland.
Conveniently located in County Louth, Darver Castle is easily accessible for guests travelling from Dublin, Meath, Monaghan, Armagh, and across Ireland and Northern Ireland.
View Gallery
A Haven of Luxury & Tranquility
Situated on 50 acres of fine parkland and wooded grounds in the rolling countryside of County Louth. A beautiful private estate steeped with history and romance. The Irish Castle has been lovingly restored by the Carville family, who continue to care for it. Exclusive use wedding venue Ireland.

Accommodation
Luxury Accommodation at Darver Castle
Book Now
Since 1432, these ancient stones have sheltered love s most precious moments. Now they invite you to create your own story amidst candlelit towers, silk-draped beds, and medieval arches. Each suite blends historic charm with indulgent luxury. Walk hand-in-hand through walled gardens where time stands still, and let six hundred years of romance inspire your forever.
To book a room, please use the link above & the wedding couple code or call our team Monday Saturday 9am 5pm.
For any assistance or queries, our Reservations Team will be happy to help:  +353 (0)42 937 9466   reservations@darvercastle.ie
Download Brochure
Darver Castle offers elegance, comfort & Luxury
Darver Castle Estate offers 50 beautifully appointed guest rooms across the Main Castle, Courtyard, and Stables, providing a unique and immersive experience for you and your wedding guests.
View Rooms
Thoughtfully Designed Accommodations
Following extensive refurbishment, each room has been individually and thoughtfully designed, blending the castle s original charm with modern luxury. Our estate can comfortably accommodate up to 110 guests in complete privacy, ensuring an intimate and unforgettable wedding experience.
Morning After Celebrations
The following morning, guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast in the charming Grain Store Breakfast Room, the perfect setting to reflect on the magical celebrations.

wikipedia.title: Darver Castle
wikipedia.extract: Darver Castle is a fortified tower and manor house located in Readypenny, Dundalk, County Louth, Ireland, dating back to the 12th century. The name "Darver" is derived from the Gaelic word "Dairbhe" meaning "Oakwood."
